articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin moves to $84,000, oil slides on latest report of Middle East progress
articles.snippet: Separate reports from Axios and CBS suggest some positive movement in U.S.-Iran negotiations.

articles.title: Kalshi loses appeal, setting up potential Supreme Court case
articles.snippet: The 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals ruled against prediction market Kalshi, siding with Ohio and Tennessee on regulating sports-event contracts under state laws.

articles.title: New York Wants to Ban Polymarket, Lawsuit Calls It 'Illegal Gambling Operation'
articles.snippet: Attorney General Letitia James and Governor Kathy Hochul allege the prediction market operates without a license and exposes New Yorkers to gambling harms.
